normative_extracts.quote: Inserting a CSS rule into an active stylesheet invalidates the style engine's selector match cache and requires style recalculation before the next layout.

pipeline_phases: Build-Time AST Style Extraction & Atomic Deduplication
Runtime CSSOM insertRule() vs Inline CSS Custom Property Binding
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Zero-runtime compilers extract static atomic classes at build time and bind dynamic values to CSS custom properties, avoiding runtime CSSStyleSheet.insertRule() invalidations.

production_failures.symptom: Scroll jank and 60+ ms Recalculate Style frames in virtualized grids
production_failures.root_cause: Passing dynamic coordinates into runtime CSS-in-JS props calls sheet.insertRule() on every scroll tick, invalidating the CSSOM.
production_failures.mitigation: Move dynamic coordinates to inline style CSS custom properties or transform properties, leaving static rules in compiled classes.

production_failures.symptom: Button overrides fail unpredictably after route-based code splitting
production_failures.root_cause: Lazy-loaded CSS chunks inject rules in network arrival order without @layer isolation.
production_failures.mitigation: Wrap base, component, and utility styles in explicit @layer declarations or atomic precedence tables.
